s1.title: One contractor for the whole finishing package.
s1.lead: Specialist facade contractors delivering finishing packages across high-end residential, commercial and industrial projects.
s1.lead2: Cosmetic and aesthetic finishing, closely managed. That focus keeps liability clear and our attention on the parts of the build people see and touch every day.

stats.label: Service lines, from rendering to asset conservation
Pillars: strict compliance, on-site presence, precise execution

svc.name: Rendering
svc.body: Acrylic, texture, sand and cement, lime and pool rendering, including high-complexity facades and bespoke architectural elements.

svc.name: Decorative Finishes
svc.body: Venetian plaster and Marmorino, microcement, concrete finishes, white set, lime and French wash for high-end interiors and facades.

svc.name: Painting
svc.body: Interior and exterior coating systems and epoxy floors, built to protect the substrate against UV and moisture over the long term.

svc.name: Substrate Installations
svc.body: Hebel, fibre cement, EPS cladding, mouldings and Basroc. The first certified Basroc installer in NSW.
svc.tag: What you don't see matters most

svc.name: Caulking and Sealant
svc.body: Window perimeters, technical joints, material junctions and fire-rated caulking. An architectural finish, not only a compliance requirement.

svc.name: Remedial and Concrete Repair
svc.body: Concrete spalling repair, controlled demolition of compromised sections, and rendering over waterproofing membranes.

svc.name: Asset Conservation
svc.body: Maintenance programs for strata managers, body corporates and home owners. Predictive and preventive care for your long-term investment.

svc.name: Labour Hire
svc.body: A specialised workforce trained to WS standards, allocated to your project when you need the trade hands and not the full package.

s10.title: Compliance focus in every layer.

Continuous presence on the job, from the first coat to the final inspection.
The human touch is the difference. Peace of mind through careful management, not factory-line claims.
